notes.title: Vote for Overcooked! 2 & Yoku’s Island Express at The Game Awards!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32941731/7652de62b4c6b4d19fb973a57e1afc9520fd7348.jpg[/img]

One of the biggest events in the gaming calendar, [url=https://thegameawards.com/]The Game Awards[/url], is fast approaching and we’re extremely proud to see that not just one but TWO Team17 releases have been nominated for awards this year!

First up, chaotic co-op cooking game [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/728880/Overcooked_2/]Overcooked! 2[/url] has been nominated for Best Family Game, while pinball-Metroidvania [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/334940/Yokus_Island_Express/]Yoku’s Island Express[/url] is up for Best Debut Indie Game!

It means so much to the hard-working people at the Team17 studio, as well as our Games Label partners at Ghost Town Games and Villa Gorilla to be recognised in these categories, but we’d be over the moon if they won. Maybe we’re biased, but we think they deserve it!

[b]How you can help![/b]
The Game Awards winners are decided by a mix of independent judges and fan votes, and in the case of Best Debut Indie Game – in which Yoku’s Island Express is running – the category is 100% decided by fans. 

We want to spread the word about these two great games and encourage more people to play them, and we can’t do it without you! So if you’ve played either of these gems and would like to help out then please [url=https://thegameawards.com/awards/]head to The Game Awards website and cast your vote[/url]!

Please note that it is possible to vote once per 24 hours (if you’re feeling super passionate about the awards) and doing so will increase the chances that your game of choice wins. So too will taking advantage of the option to share your choice to social media when prompted to do so.

[b]Try the Yoku’s Island Express demo![/b]
If you haven’t played Yoku’s Island Express and would like to try it before voting, there’s a free demo available on the Steam page. Why not give it a whirl and find out what all the fuss is about…

Thank you all for reading (and hopefully [url=https://thegameawards.com/awards/]voting[/url]). We’ll see you all at The Game Awards on December 6th!

notes.title: Team17 - 100th Game Celebration
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32941731/ce201387f7d4e82ee6ad0624c277acea9e6a229a.png[/img]

With the release of PLANET ALPHA on 4th September 2018, Team17 will have released 100 games! This landmark includes games developed and/or published here at Team17, ranging from our early Amiga days with the likes of Alien Breed, Body Blows and Project X, through the explosion in popularity of the Worms series, our work-for-hire period on franchises like Lemmings and Leisure Suit Larry right through to the modern age and our indie games label featuring The Escapists, Overcooked and Yooka-Laylee!

https://youtu.be/CfGBMGPl_5s

Our celebration begins today with the retrospective video above, as well as a new trailer for [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/485030/PLANET_ALPHA/]PLANET ALPHA[/url], available to pre-order now with a 10% discount!

There's more to come too! Keep an eye on Team17's [url=https://www.facebook.com/Team17/]Facebook[/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/Team17Ltd]Twitter[/url] channels for more activities throughout the year, including behind-the-scenes retropspectives, competitions and fun with friends!

What's your favourite Team17 game of all time? Why not join us in the official [url=discord.gg/team17]Team17 Discord[/url] server and let us know?

notes.title: Flockers Roundup
notes.content:
Shepherds Assemble!

We hope you’ve been having as much fun [strike]slaughtering[/strike] saving sheep as we’ve had seeing your posts and screenshots. We’ve been keeping a close eye on these here pages, so we thought we’d share some of our favourite moments.

First up is our favourite user created level so far:

[b]Level of Bafflement, Part 2[/b]

This intricate level will take several tries to get the hang of, but once you learn it’s secrets and master the timings, you may scrape by with one star.

[img=http://i.imgur.com/boK9H20.jpg]

This is certainly one of the more challenging user created levels, and it’s most tantalising, yet frustrating aspect is the glimmer of possibility once you know what to expect.

[img=http://i.imgur.com/EhrYwDF.jpg]

You think you’ll be able to get three stars and save all of the sheep, but then too late you’ll remember another obstacle or explosive, and you’ll reach for the restart button once more, in despair.

[img=http://i.imgur.com/w4dSLe2.jpg]

So thanks MrKat7214, thanks a bunch.

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=314603072&searchtext=]Download it here.[/url]

[b]OSX Update[/b]

In the latest update, we’ve improved performance with AMD graphics cards on OSX systems. We discovered an issue which was causing some OSX players to experience poor performance in-game, and this has been fixed in the latest update.

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/260330/discussions/2/624074858735302798/]Read the post here.[/url]

[b]Screenshots[/b]

We’ve been having a fair few screenshots sent our way, so here are a few of our favourites:

[img=http://cloud-3.steampowered.com/ugc/3334098169354456834/46DCABD3077D569ED979EEB9B99E7334047C6A05/]
From [url=http://steamcommunity.com/id/CueZero] CueZero [/url]

[img=http://cloud-4.steampowered.com/ugc/548633844878775591/3A315201ADB0D7C551E168EAB9BDD325900DE6DA/]
From [url=http://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561197969112370] Apodis [/url]

[img=http://cloud-4.steampowered.com/ugc/44232590148881288/537A8A7C79B78B54A6BF587FCA92468D86945318/]
From [url=http://steamcommunity.com/id/flashn00b] flashn00b [/url]

[b]Finally[/b]

As a final send off, why not check out Sparrow’s Flockers walkthrough on YouTube?

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=L1PbJf3LrKA&list=UUoI2I6avZGKSGu2MvmXw3eg] Just click this link to give it a watch! [/url]

From all of us at Team17, thanks for [strike]killing[/strike] saving our sheep.

Jason_Team17

notes.title: Flockers: Release Update
notes.content:
[img=http://www.goodgame.hr/wp-content/uploads/2014/03/flockers-header02-600x300.jpg]

Shepherds!

We're but 2 days away from the launch of Flockers as a full game here on Steam. It's been a hell of a journey through Early Access - together we've slain bugs, tweaked features and saved countless scores of sheep from their horrible, weaponised fate created by the [url=http://twitter.com/wormsteam17]Worms[/url]. 

...we've also accidentally led countless scores [i]more[/i] to their doom, but let's gloss over that minor hiccup.

We can't thank everyone who took part in our Early Access enough. Ewe've* been excellent. The feedback you have given us has helped us to make a really great game that is [url=http://www.metacritic.com/game/pc/flockers]already getting brilliant reviews, both by players and the games press.[/url]

As small thanks, we've uploaded the release version of Flockers to Steam today. Anyone with Early Access can play the full Flockers experience 2 days before general release. 

Here's the skinny on the release update:

[b]New Stuff[/b]
[list]
[*]5 New Campaign Levels, bringing the total level count to 60! (NOT including Bonus / Meat Maker levels)
[*]1 New Bonus Level to unlock!
[*]More Rewards available to unlock!
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes & Tweaks[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed a crash that occassionally occurred when launching the game
[*]Fixed a crash in the options menu
[*]Fixed an OpenGL error that caused some users to be unable to launch the game
[*]Fixed an issue effecting blood graphics on some Intel graphics cards
[*]Made optimisations to min spec graphics cards – Flockers can now support Nvidia GeForce 8600 GS/AMD Radeon HD 4650 and equivalent.
[*]Tweaked the loading screens to make transitioning between levels smoother
[/list]

Over the next 2 days, we'll also be removing all the developer scores from the in-game leaderboards. Your scores will remain, and this is your chance to set the bar for the influx of new players heading to Flockers over the coming months. Do us proud, make them work for the top spot.

It's not all in-game though. We need your [url=http://steamcommunity.com/workshop/browse/?appid=260330]Meat Maker[/url] levels, your [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/260330/guides/]Guides[/url], your [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/260330/reviews/]Reviews[/url] and [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/260330/discussions/]Discussions[/url] to help make the Flockers community an amazing place to be. I'll be highlighting the very best of your creations; in the forums, on [url=http://twitter.com/flockersgame]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/FlockersGame]Facebook[/url] and here within Team17 too - we all can't wait to see what you can make!

From everyone here at Team17, thank ewe** for saving our sheep.

MT17

*That's the last time I'll do that during early access, I promise.

**I lied.

[*]Fixed an issue which caused formation boxes to stay on screen after the level is reset

[*]Fixed an issue which caused the bottom sheep in a formation to slide down slopes
[*]Fixed an issue causing the Exploder Sheep's timer remaining after the game is paused and then restarted
[*]Fixed an issue causing camera weirdness
[*]Added text explaining how to unlock Lambo and the Cyber Sheep

[*]Fixed an issue causing the game to crash after changing filters at the Leaderboard

[*]Fixed an issue causing Jumper sheep to miss the exit in level 26.
[*]Fixed an issue with the Level 29 landscape, which was much higher than its collision area

[*]Fixed an issue that allowed Giblets to press Constant Switches
[*]Fixed an issue with the level select button, which was obstructed by the button above it

Best regards,

notes.title: Version #283 of Flockers out now
notes.content:
For notes on the changes and fixes included in this update, please see below:

Level 3
- New marquee helper decorative formations.
- Removed spikes from next to wooden box.
- Increased height of wooden box.
- Added a block to the end of the moving platform near the exit point.
(score requirements have not changed)
 
Level 6
- Removed 2 guillotines from the end of the level.
- Slowed remaining guillotine down.
- Moved exit point on ‘Robosheep’ further forward to avoid any potential sheep deaths on buzzsaw.
- Extra 2-step formation and 2 releases so that the sleeping sheep near the rolling pObject can be saved.
(score requirements have not changed)
 
Level 8
- Edits made to the left side of the landscape. A hazard has been removed and teleports have been added as a means of getting onto the robot.
- A hazard was removed from the lower right section to make it easier for players to work out what the constant switch's function is.
- Only 1 constant switch is now used instead of the previous 2.
- Changes made to the speed of the platform and the underside of the landscape to the right of the platform. This makes it possible to save the sheep sat on the switch.
- 10 more sheep have been added to the right side.
- Score requirements have been updated to 10000 / 230000 / 460000
 
Level 21
- Timer has been reduced from 71,000 minutes to 10 minutes. 0042346: MF1: Functional: Level timer on Level 21 begins at 71582:47
 
Early Access DLC
- Early access bonus content is now available and can be found in the Flockers root install folder (C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Flockers).
- Content can be found in the folders; Flockers Art, Flockers Soundtrack and Flockers Wallpapers.
 
Enjoy!
 
Thank you,
Team17

notes.title: EGX Rezzed
notes.content:
Hi all!

Welcome to Flockers.

We're incredibly excited about the game launching into Early Access next week and we can't wait to hear all your feedback! The [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/260330/discussions/]Steam Discussion pages[/url] are live now, so please feel free to start posting in there if you have any questions about the game or feedback for us.

Last month we globally unveiled Flockers at EGX Rezzed, an indie-focused UK gaming expo.

We had an absolute blast showing off the game for the very first time to the public and press. If you attended EGX Rezzed and came and played Flockers, or any of the other Team17 titles on show, then thank you!

Here's some feedback from the event to give you guys a better idea of what Flockers is all about! :)

[h1]Previews[/h1]
[list]
[*]"as great as it sounds," [url=http://www.digitalspy.co.uk/gaming/feature/a560893/flockers-a-first-look-at-team-17s-new-lemmings-style-puzzle-game.html]Digital Spy[/url]
[*]"I for one can’t wait to see more of what this dark and twisted game can throw my way", [url=http://thegamershub.net/2014/04/flockers-preview/]TheGamersHub[/url]
[*]"The excellent potential for levels to be created with ever more complex and ludicrous deathtraps is clear, and it had me laughing on several occasions, but underneath it, there’s a tricky little puzzler," [url=http://www.thesixthaxis.com/2014/04/01/fluffy-little-flockers-team-17s-mutton-murder-simulator/]The Sixth Axis[/url]
[*]"The graphics style is a lovely cartoony steampunk world, and the sheep are particularly delightful - which makes it all the more distressing when they get squished by a giant metal mallet, but that's all part of the fun," [url=http://www.strategyinformer.com/pc/flockers/previews.html]Strategy Informer[/url]
[*]"It's a refreshingly different type of game for the developers," [url=http://www.eurogamer.net/articles/2014-04-07-team-17-moves-on-from-worms-with-lemmings-inspired-flockers]Eurogamer[/url]
[*]"What sets Flockers apart ... is how much of a smile it brings to your face through every single aspect," [url=http://www.n3rdabl3.co.uk/2014/03/egx-rezzed-hands-team-17s-flockers/]N3rdabl3[/url]
[*]"I was hooked. The level of fun on show is immense. Just the sheer value in watching events unfold, in seeing gravity distort and giant balls roll toward your vulnerable sheep… it’s just damn fun," [url=http://www.nerfed.co.uk/oli-rezzed-2014-part-4-war-for-the-overworld-flockers/7503]Nerfed[/url]
[*]"a blood-soaked and thoroughly sadistic take on classic Lemmings gameplay, liberally flavoured with lashings of anarchic British humour and classic Worms references," [url=http://www.dealspwn.com/flockers-handson-team-17s-sadistic-adorable-worms-tiein-170126]Dealspwn[/url]
[*]"It's dark, macabre fun," [url=http://news.en.softonic.com/meet-flockers-the-new-puzzle-game-from-team17]Softonic[/url][/list]

[h1]Videos[/h1]
[list]
[*][url=http://www.twitch.tv/twitch/b/515602827]Twitch/Yogscast: Hat Films play Flockers[/url] (Skip forward to 05:24:50)
[*][url=http://youtu.be/kwysszd7H-k]Eurogamer: Flockers - Preview/Exclusive Interview[/url]
[*][url=http://www.dealspwn.com/flockers-video-playthrough-170270]Dealspwn: Flockers Video Preview | Watch Jon Suck At Team 17's Sadistic Woolly Puzzler[/url]

Thanks! ːSheepː
